items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-08-31
items.q: I used to go to see him when he had a little barbecue place... Had sessions there on Monday nights of all the New Orleans musicians... I only heard maybe one or two

ctx.x: Yeah, he looks... His daughter, he has a daughter about nine or ten, and he's a little lighter.

Yeah, it's surprising. A couple more generations, they'll be faded out completely. Yeah. Another interview I have here, which is these longhand things are in pitiful shape as far as being word for word, is Paul Norez. I used to go to see him when he had a little barbecue place up on North State Street, about 800 block. Specialized in a secret formulae claimed of barbecue sauce. He was probably a pretty good cook though, and still a good trumpet player. Had sessions there on Monday nights of all the New Orleans…
Mr. Russell, I would like to take all of these and Xerox them. I'll have them typed as like they are and regard them as rough drafts. So if anything happened to you, we at least have them.
